title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
ii.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
iii.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
iv.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
v.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
seed_phrase: i.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain
